心行處滅 s1 o2: Continuation of the Old Essentials of Venerable Masters (續古尊宿語要), in Baoning Renyong's hall address. A source-unattributed formula says that wisdom and consciousness cannot know it and that language and mental activity cease; Baoning's explicitly marked counter begins only afterward. The line, expanded context, section header, title, TEI metadata, exact search, and closest parallel do not name the formula's originator.

心行處滅 s1 o3: Continuation of the Old Essentials of Venerable Masters (續古尊宿語要), in Baoning Renyong's hall address. The longer span joins a source-unattributed formula containing the headword to Baoning's explicit counter that mental activity is not extinguished. Because the headword belongs only to the first proposition, Baoning is retained as contextual counter-speaker rather than made its source.
